name: Cornell Arts Quad modern reference scene

policies.source: Public Wikimedia Commons API; more providers can be added without changing input schema
policies.date: Requires asserted photographic capture date >= 2000, not upload date or building construction year
policies.licenses: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or public domain; retain attribution and license URL
policies.originals: Download source originals, not 1024px thumbnails; retain original bytes and SHA256
policies.environment: Retain observed grounds, paths, neighboring structures and vegetation; dynamic/nonrigid regions need separate reliability labels
policies.no_geometry_substitutes: No map extrusion, authored buildings, generative completion or invented component alignment
policies.limits: No fixed per-building image count cap. Explicit disk safeguards are not quality rejections.
